_about: Sword & Shield-era English theme decks, written 2026-11-26: 9 decks (Sword & Shield: Rillaboom, Cinderace, Inteleon; Rebel Clash: Zacian, Zamazenta; Darkness Ablaze: Galarian Darmanitan, Galarian Sirfetch'd; Vivid Voltage: Charizard, Drednaw). Bulbapedia's Theme Deck page: V Battle Decks replaced theme decks after Vivid Voltage, so Champion's Path (swsh35), Shining Fates (swsh45), Battle Styles through Crown Zenith and Pokemon GO had none; tcgcsv groups for those sets list no theme decks (Pokemon GO only has V Battle Decks, already out of scope). Lists: Bulbapedia deck pages (MediaWiki API wikitext) and TCGsync product pages' Deck List; all 9 agree card-for-card by name and count. Card ids resolved by set + number against data/<set>.json (all names match; only swsh1-178 is spelled 'Professor's Research (Professor Magnolia)' on the site). Basic Energy: no source names the print; site's Sword & Shield 2020 print assumed (energy-<type>-swsh). TCGplayer: sealed decks are in the set's own group (swsh1 2585, swsh2 2626, swsh3 2675, swsh4 2701); Cracked Ice showcase prints are in group 1840 'Deck Exclusives'. marketPrice = TCGplayer market via tcgcsv at the time of writing. TCGplayer 'Set of N' / Display / Code Card products are not decks and were not used. Skipped as already on site or out of scope: swshp Victini V and Gardevoir V battle decks, V Battle Decks, League Battle Decks, Battle Academy, Trainer's Toolkits, Build & Battle Boxes. Decks hold exactly 60 cards; nothing else is modelled except coin/code card in extras.

decks.name: Rillaboom
decks.showcasePrint: Cracked Ice Holofoil print, exclusive to this theme deck (1 copy); the set's pack print differs. Remaining copies regular Rare.
decks.extras: 60-card deck, damage counters, one-player playmat, deckbox, custom coin (featuring Grookey), Quick Start Rules booklet, TCG Online code card (TCGplayer sells the code card separately as 'Code Card - ...'). No booster pack. (Bulbapedia deck page intro.)

decks.notes: Basic Energy: no source names the print; the Sword & Shield era's own basic Energy (2020 print) is on the site as energy-<type>-swsh, so energy print assumed. Both lists agree card-for-card by name and count (only difference: the site spells swsh1-178 as 'Professor's Research (Professor Magnolia)', the sources just 'Professor's Research'; Bulbapedia notes the deck copy is the Non Holofoil print). Rillaboom is 2 copies of swsh1-15: Bulbapedia lists 1 Rare Holo (the deck-exclusive Cracked Ice Holofoil) + the rest regular Rare. Card ids resolved by set+number; cards from earlier sets keep their own set id (swsh1/swsh2/swsh3/swsh4).  Showcase TCGplayer product is in group 1840 'Deck Exclusives'.
